note: Profiles are usage modes, not independent benchmark counts. Capabilities are source-reported, not independently executed. Real data, interaction and new physical execution are separate properties.

profiles.name: DiscoveryWorld
profiles.focus: Scientific investigations and hypothesis testing
profiles.limits: Designed scenarios and rules; broad discovery claims need transfer beyond those scenarios.

training.reward: Task and investigation scoring are described by the project.
training.reset: Source-provided environment; exact reset semantics not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: BoxingGym
profiles.focus: Experimental design, model discovery and explanation transfer
profiles.limits: Scientific domain grounding does not turn simulated observations into real measurements.

training.reward: EIG and prediction-related evaluation are described.
training.reset: Generative environments are documented; training wrappers not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: NewtonBench
profiles.focus: Discovering modified laws through experimentation
profiles.limits: Counterfactual physical laws are intentionally simulated; original-law memory remains a separate control.

training.reward: Code-assisted evaluation is described; repository reports an RL-environment integration.
training.reset: Task instances are documented; restoration behavior not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: CausaLab
profiles.focus: Causal mechanism recovery versus predictive success
profiles.limits: Ground-truth graph scoring must be interpreted under the supplied information and identifiability assumptions.

training.reward: Task prediction and mechanism evaluation are described in the paper.
training.reset: Random SCM episodes are described; implementation not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: CausalARC
profiles.focus: Abstract, causal and counterfactual reasoning with world-model-generated demonstrations
profiles.limits: Observation/intervention/counterfactual feedback is supplied as demonstrations; do not assume unrestricted active lab access.

training.reward: Task-level correctness; TTT is one evaluated setting.
training.reset: Task generation is described; reset protocol depends on setting.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: ScienceWorld
profiles.focus: Interactive scientific task execution
profiles.limits: Elementary-science reasoning and execution are enabling capabilities, not proof of discovering novel laws.

training.reward: Task completion scoring is described in the paper.
training.reset: Environment episodes are described; exact interface not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: DiscoveryBench real-workflow subset
profiles.focus: Data-driven hypothesis discovery from scientific datasets
profiles.limits: Tasks are grounded in published workflows; new analysis is not new physical data acquisition.

training.reward: Hypothesis/workflow evaluation is described; evaluator validity must be checked.
training.reset: Restore the analysis workspace and fixed inputs.
training.branching: Workspace branching not audited.

profiles.name: DiscoveryBench synthetic subset
profiles.focus: Controlled variation in data-driven discovery complexity
profiles.limits: Keep this subset separate from real-workflow results; semantic generation and structural data construction have their own assumptions.

training.reward: Hypothesis/workflow evaluation is described.
training.reset: Restore fixed inputs and workspace.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: ScienceAgentBench
profiles.focus: Executing data-driven scientific analysis tasks
profiles.limits: Published research tasks and code execution do not imply online laboratory experimentation.

training.reward: Task-specific evaluation is provided; training use needs split and contamination controls.
training.reset: Restore files, dependencies and workspace; implementation not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: GeneDisco
profiles.focus: Budgeted active learning over genetic intervention outcomes
profiles.limits: Queries reveal recorded outcomes; out-of-pool experiments cannot be measured without another backend.

training.reward: Active-learning and discovery performance are evaluated across acquisition cycles.
training.reset: Pool/acquisition state is reusable; exact wrapper not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: Causal Chambers recorded datasets
profiles.focus: Causal methodology using physical-system observations and interventions
profiles.limits: Recorded physical interventions remain offline evidence when downloaded as datasets.

training.reward: Depends on the chosen causal/representation task.
training.reset: Dataset state is fixed.
training.branching: Data reuse is possible; no new physical branch is executed.

profiles.name: Causal Chambers physical simulators
profiles.focus: Simulation-based experimentation with chamber models
profiles.limits: A model of a real device is still a simulator; model mismatch and sim-to-real transfer need separate evaluation.

training.reward: Task-dependent.
training.reset: Simulator behavior is source-reported, not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: Causal Chambers remote physical lab
profiles.focus: Collecting new measurements by interacting with a physical chamber
profiles.limits: Access is requested separately; physical resets, throughput and repeatability are not equivalent to simulator resets.

training.reward: Task-dependent; not independently integrated here.
training.reset: Physical preparation and reset conditions must be specified.
training.branching: No assumption of exact physical state cloning.

profiles.name: SciDisco process-verifiable environments
profiles.focus: Turn-level RL for scientific data analysis
profiles.limits: Hidden evidence graphs and templates define the verification scope; this is not online physical experimentation.

training.reward: Process-verifiable evidence and turn-level credit are described.
training.reset: Environment construction is described in the paper; runtime not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: as-bench replay campaigns
profiles.focus: Budgeted closed-loop campaigns over held-back experimental records
profiles.limits: Early project; README reports a replay backend, not new physical execution. Results have not been independently reproduced here.

training.reward: Project describes verifier gates and withheld-design evaluation.
training.reset: Stateful lab service is described; reset semantics not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: as-bench digital-twin campaign
profiles.focus: Campaigns using a hidden process model
profiles.limits: A twin supplies model predictions; grounding in real data does not make them new physical measurements.

training.reward: Project-specific verifier gates.
training.reset: Not audited.
training.branching: Not audited.

profiles.name: as-bench live backend contract
profiles.focus: An interface contract for future physical-lab jobs
profiles.limits: README status is contract defined. Do not list as an already demonstrated live benchmark; physical execution is unverified.

training.reward: Proposed contract only.
training.reset: Not established.
training.branching: Not established.

profiles.name: MLE-bench
profiles.focus: Iterative ML engineering on 75 recreated Kaggle competitions.
profiles.limits: Known competition tasks; public solutions/contamination and resource differences require controls. Computational training runs do not collect new physical measurements.

training.reward: Competition metrics and medal thresholds; the public validity tool does not expose hidden test scores in the paper protocol.
training.reset: Fresh execution environments and fixed datasets; downloads/compute prerequisites apply.
training.branching: Independent runs are possible; filesystem/container snapshots are an implementation choice, not an audited standard contract.

profiles.name: PaperBench
profiles.focus: Reproduce research papers against hierarchical implementation/execution/result rubrics.
profiles.limits: Replication supplies the target method. Automated judging can err; exposing the hidden grading rubric for training changes the task.

training.reward: Weighted rubric score including clean reproduction and result match; code-development-only scoring is a separate mode.
training.reset: Clean VM reproduction is described; full reproduction requires datasets, dependencies and compute.
training.branching: Candidate code branches are possible, but each independent execution/grade must be budgeted.

profiles.name: RE-Bench
profiles.focus: Seven bounded AI R&D tasks with human comparisons and objective scores.
profiles.limits: Small selected task set. Best-of-k and longer runs use different allocations and need comparable total resource accounting.

training.reward: Task-specific quantitative scores, including runtime and model loss.
training.reset: Task repositories specify environments and starting artifacts; hardware and data requirements vary.
training.branching: Independent agent attempts are reported; full state cloning was not audited.

profiles.name: MLGym-Bench
profiles.focus: Gym-compatible computational research interface and 13 diverse ML tasks.
profiles.limits: A benchmark/framework enabling RL does not establish a trained discovery policy. Task performance can improve through ordinary engineering.

training.reward: Task-defined validation/test metrics; evaluator access must match the chosen benchmark protocol.
training.reset: Gym-style task/environment initialization; dataset and runtime setup are required.
training.branching: Modular execution supports agent experimentation; exact snapshot/branch semantics are not established by this review.

profiles.name: MLRC-Bench
profiles.focus: Research-method proposals and repository-level implementation on seven competitions.
profiles.limits: Competition effectiveness and scientific novelty are distinct; public content and source-paper guidance can contaminate evaluation.

training.reward: Objective test effectiveness relative to baselines/human solutions, under runtime and GPU-memory constraints.
training.reset: Task-specific starter repositories and data splits; computational prerequisites differ.
training.branching: Alternative implementations can be evaluated independently; account for all evaluator/compute calls.

profiles.name: LLM-SRBench
profiles.focus: Equation discovery with transformed known equations and synthetic terms.
profiles.limits: Uses supplied datasets rather than autonomous physical measurement. LLM-assisted construction/judging and known scientific priors remain relevant.

training.reward: Numerical ID/OOD fidelity and symbolic-equivalence metrics; these measure different properties.
training.reset: Fixed versioned problem/data instances; no simulator or laboratory reset is required.
training.branching: Candidate expressions can be tested repeatedly; evaluation and search budget should be counted.

profiles.name: ACDB initial ladder
profiles.focus: Causal graph recovery with budgeted hard interventions and abstention.
profiles.limits: Small linear-Gaussian causally sufficient worlds. The initial dense ladder has a high random-graph floor and is explicitly a calibration/audit report.

training.reward: Separate skeleton recovery, directed-DAG recovery and intervention-efficiency scoring.
training.reset: Paper describes generated paired instances and a new session per world; a public implementation was not verified.
training.branching: Do not assume branchable sessions from the paper API alone.

profiles.name: Kosmos radiobiology audit (three cases)
profiles.focus: Audit proposed biological relationships against empirical null models.
profiles.limits: A three-case study rather than a standardized broad benchmark; small samples and analytic choices limit generalization.

training.reward: Claim-specific correlation/survival statistics and random-gene or permutation nulls; no shared RL reward API.
training.reset: Fixed public GEO datasets and specified analyses; an executable reset wrapper was not verified.
training.branching: Alternative analyses are possible but need multiple-testing and provenance controls.

profiles.name: Science-Gym
profiles.focus: Seven scientific simulations with experiment collection and equation-problem interfaces.
profiles.limits: Simulation, not live physics. No explicit new-object/variable discovery interface; droplet-friction symbolic ground truth is listed as unknown.

training.reward: Gym task rewards and equation/problem evaluation are separate; a control reward alone does not establish explanation recovery.
training.reset: Gym-compatible reset/step APIs are documented; per-problem settings differ.
training.branching: Simulation can be reinitialized; arbitrary state cloning was not independently audited.

profiles.name: DISCERN
profiles.focus: Data integrity, analysis verification and evidence-sensitive hypothesis revision.
profiles.limits: Real data with controlled defects and constructed counterfactual dossiers; no new physical measurements. Rubric/judge and domain effects require attention.

training.reward: Level-specific scores and claim-level evaluation; using evaluation judgments as training rewards needs an independent hidden audit.
training.reset: Versioned task/data bundles; exact training wrapper and reset semantics were not executed here.
training.branching: Counterfactual task variants are evaluation cases, not experimentally performed physical interventions.

profiles.name: A-Lab demonstration
profiles.focus: Autonomous solid-state synthesis and physical XRD feedback.
profiles.limits: Laboratory demonstration, not a turnkey public benchmark. The publisher updated synthesis counts; phase interpretation and material novelty require scrutiny.

training.reward: Measured phase/yield feedback guides recipe search; computational stability is separate from successful synthesis.
training.reset: Requires physical equipment, consumables and preparation. Samples/devices cannot be reset like a simulator.
training.branching: Additional experiments consume resources; arbitrary branching or cloning is unavailable.

profiles.name: Robin laboratory-feedback demonstration
profiles.focus: Hypothesis proposals and analysis updated from cell-assay and RNA-seq evidence.
profiles.limits: System demonstration with scientist-run experiments and some human changes to assay choices; no generic public lab access or discovery benchmark.

training.reward: Experimental measurements plus scientific interpretation; no standardized per-step RL reward is supplied.
training.reset: Cell culture and assays require human work, new samples and laboratory preparation.
training.branching: Independent biological repeats are possible at physical cost; identical-state branching is not provided.

profiles.name: Virtual Lab physical validation
profiles.focus: Computational nanobody design followed by wet-lab binding validation.
profiles.limits: The team is virtual; validation is physical. Humans run scripts/experiments. This is a demonstration rather than a public interactive physical benchmark.

training.reward: Computational design scores differ from physical binding measurements; neither is clinical efficacy.
training.reset: Agent discussions can be restarted, while physical validation requires new samples and laboratory work.
training.branching: Multiple computational proposals can be branched; physical tests are new experiments with costs.

profiles.name: AI Research Agents Narrow Scientific Exploration — idea-space audit
profiles.focus: Breadth and literature proximity of agent-generated research ideas
profiles.limits: Text-space and historical impact proxies; no independent experimental validation of generated hypotheses.

training.reward: Reported breadth, proximity and future-alignment measures; not a supplied online training reward.
training.reset: Fixed literature and idea-analysis study; interactive reset is not applicable.
training.branching: Not applicable to this analysis profile.

profiles.name: Into the Unknown
profiles.focus: Carry out scientist-proposed open follow-up research and submit a paper, code, and execution evidence.
profiles.limits: Human-specified directions and rubrics constrain openness; tasks are computational and do not certify autonomous problem generation or new laboratory measurements. Automated judgments are fallible, and scientific merit still requires expert assessment.

training.reward: Public task-specific rubric graders report integrity, completeness, sufficiency, and strict joint pass rates; author baselines are evaluated with an agentic judge. No independently audited RL reward wrapper.
training.reset: The official runner prepares a fresh task workspace with the supplied original code and data. Per-task dependencies and CPU/GPU resources must be provisioned.
training.branching: Independent workspace copies support separate attempts; baseline agents can continue for up to five review/retry rounds. Standard snapshot/branch semantics are not audited.
